mentions.name: AssistedList
mentions.description: This website helps families research and compare senior care options with real prices and transparent data, starting with Florida, and plans to add AI advisors to support informed decisions and products that cut out the referral middleman.
mentions.problem: Finding and researching senior care is a sales funnel: real options and prices are hidden behind walls, search results are dominated by SEO pages, phone-number capture, and referral incentives that sell contact info to elder care facilities, especially under time pressure.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m working on https://assistedlist.com

From personal experience finding and researching senior care ends up being a big trap, they lead you into a sales funnel before you can clearly compare real options.
